definition: Orbit counter for the GRACE-FO satellites (orbit number, position and magnetic local time)
description: Orbit counter product for the GRACE-FO satellites, provided in CDF format on the Swarm Dissemination Server in the folders /Multimission/GRACE-FO/ORBCNT/Sat_1 and /Multimission/GRACE-FO/ORBCNT/Sat_2. The ORBCNT files give a quick overview of altitudes and magnetic local time and can be used for conjunction analysis.

Latitude,,,1,CDF_DOUBLE
Longitude,,,1,CDF_DOUBLE
Radius,,,1,CDF_DOUBLE
OrbitNo,,,1,CDF_DOUBLE
MLT,,,1,CDF_DOUBLE
details: There is one file series per spacecraft: GF1_ORBCNT_* (GRACE-FO-1, folder Sat_1) and GF2_ORBCNT_* (GRACE-FO-2, folder Sat_2). Each file covers the period from 30 May 2018 up to the end time given in its file name, e.g. GF1_ORBCNT_20180530T003839_20260925T055841_0201.cdf.
